title: (Pwn2Own) Apple macOS WindowServer Dragging Space Use-After-Free Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on vulnerable installations of Apple macOS. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the WindowServer. The issue results from the lack of validating the existence of an object prior to performing operations on the object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges under the context of the WindowServer.
